# services/packs/

## Purpose
Turns the reports' figures into the documents a director forwards to a bank. Two independent paths share this directory:
- **Legacy section pack** (`management`, `monthly`): `ReportPack` -> `buildPackDocument` -> `PackDocument`, rendered by screen, PDF and PowerPoint. Files: `packDocument`, `packSections`, `packSectionData`, `packDeckModel`, `pptxExportService`, `packKvFormat`, `packChartOptions`.
- **Board pack** (`board`): twelve composed pages. `figures/` supplies the figure set and the integrity gate, `narrative/` the derived sentences, `pages/` composes the `PackPagesDocument`. See each sibling `.claude.md`.

Pure composition except the readers named below. No React.

## Caller contract
- `buildPackDocument(pack, trend)`: callers are `usePackPrintData.ts` (`?print=1`, so the PDF) and `pages/api/accounting/packs/[id]/pptx.ts`. The interactive `report-packs.tsx` does NOT build a document; it uses `reports/statementRows/packMappers.ts` plus `marginKvItem`.
- `buildBoardPackDocument({ companyId, from, to, preparedBy, generatedAt })` (`pages/boardPackDocument.ts`): the board pack's one meeting with the database. Callers: `packs/[id]/pages.ts` (the print page's single fetch) and `packs/[id]/pdf.ts` (a diagnostic re-compose when a render fails). Fetches are sequential (one pg client under `withAuth`); `buildBoardPackPages` is synchronous and takes values.
- Print token: `packPrintApiPaths(type)` is the authority for what a render may fetch. `board` -> only `packs/board/pages`; `management`/`monthly` -> `reports-pack` + `trend`. A path the print page fetches that is missing here is stubbed (Playwright) or 401s (Gotenberg), so the PDF ships a loading state. Pinned by `packPrintFetchParity.dom.test.tsx`.
- `pdf.ts` is `withRenderSlot(withAuth(...))`; the slot is taken outside `withAuth` (see `src/lib/pdf/.claude.md`). The print page signals readiness with `[data-print-ready]`.
- `getPackTrend(companyId, to, months)` is the one DB reader outside the board's fetch.

## Rules
- **Figures are copied, never derived.** Mappers and composers translate what `reports/` computed. A figure that needs computing belongs in `reports/`.
- **A board figure comes from the figure set (`figures/`) with provenance.** Nothing computes a number in a component or a page composer.
- **null survives.** A KPI value is `number | null`; null is normal for non-positive equity. Never default to 0. Margins go through `marginKvItem` (`NO_MARGIN_REASON`); KPIs through `scorecardFigure`/`formatScorecardValue`. An unscored ratio is neutral, never red.
- **Fail rather than print a blank or a fabricated zero.** A section type with no blocks throws `UnknownPackSectionError`; a section blob missing a field throws `MissingPackFieldError` (`packSectionData.ts`). No `?? 0` fallbacks on `PackSection.data`.
- **Integrity gates refuse via `PackRefusal`** (`packRefusal.ts`); only a `PackRefusal` becomes a 422 with its `userMessage`. Anything else is a 500 with a fixed sentence and the raw text goes to the log.
- **Degrading reads** (comparative, budget, page 11 sources, receivables decomposition, cash flows) each run in their own savepoint (`withSavepoint`), taken sequentially, and only a failed read (`isFailedRead`, `packFailedRead.ts`) degrades to a printed absence. A defect is re-thrown.
- **Number formatting is opt-in.** `formatStatementFigure`/`formatPct` are legacy-by-default; the pack passes `pack: true` or a money `scale`. Negatives are brackets everywhere; prose takes percentages through `pctWithWord`/`formatPctLevel`. `packBracketIsTheSign.test.ts` lints source for a hand-typed bracket around a figure.
- **Statements:** page 7 prints equity before liabilities and closes on `Total equity and liabilities` (held to the two totals by a statement identity). The pack's cash flows come from the direct-method statement; investing is NET investing and `capitalExpenditure` stays unpopulated, so free cash flow is marked not meaningful.
- **A change in a percentage is stated in points** (`PackKpiDelta.unit`), worded by `deltaWithWord` ("pp" on tiles).
- **Charts:** SVG is rendered by `renderChartSvg` and branded `TrustedChartSvg` only through the two guards in `lib/charts/trustedChartSvg.ts`; the JSON boundary (`pages/packDocumentWire.ts`) re-adopts every SVG field and must never `as TrustedChartSvg`. Pack charts use `packChartOptions.ts` (browser/PDF); the deck uses native PowerPoint charts (`packDeckModel.ts`), so a look change touches both on purpose. `afs/serverChartSvg.ts` serves the AFS PDF only and takes `DEFAULT_CHART_PALETTE` from here. Plot inset is `CHART_GUTTER_PX`, symmetric, `containLabel` unset.
- Chart ink and label colours are held to WCAG 4.5:1 by `packInkContrast.test.ts` and `packChartOptions.test.ts`; do not change a colour without them.
- **One typeface, no font CDN.** Fonts are self-hosted (`fontsSelfHosted.test.ts`); chart text carries `PACK_FONT_STACK`. Page margins come only from `PDF_MARGIN_MM`; never add a CSS `@page` margin.
- **Page height model must never under-estimate** Chromium (`pages/packTextMetrics.ts`, `WIDTH_SAFETY`). A page that does not fit drops content and says so; it never starts a second sheet. Details in `pages/.claude.md`.
- **Logo:** the server fetches the tenant logo once (`packBrandForRender.ts`, `safeFetch`, size/type/time caps) and the cover carries a `data:` URI. An unusable logo is dropped, not refused. Nothing client-side may import that file (`node:dns`).
- **Commentary is deterministic or signed.** Commentary is `approved` or `derived`; draft renders nothing. Draft status is read once, in `pages/packDraftState.ts`, and a pack is FINAL only on positive evidence (closed period AND an approval).
